extracted.intended_audience: English-speaking Christians and general readers interested in the history and missions of the Waldensian (Vaudois) Church
extracted.subtask_description: Chapter excerpt from a 19th-century historical account describing the revival, missionary activity, educational and ecclesiastical reforms, and notable figures (e.g., General Beckwith, Dr. Gilly) in the Waldensian valleys and their mission work in Italy and Sicily.
